source: vault Specs/open-source-plan/phase-c-sets.md, section C3, copied verbatim
shared_instruction: Build one complete, responsive single-page website in the provided project. Implement the requested content and include all five visible anchor types where the task supports them: largest heading, body text, primary CTA, navigation, and a repeated card/item. Use accessible semantic HTML, no login, no external design-gallery assets, and no unrequested backend. Do not ask questions. Stop when the page is runnable.

arms.piggyback-brief: Use the supplied Piggyback BRIEF.md measured from the named CC0 starter as the visual specification. Do not receive the starter screenshot or source. Preserve the task content; implement the measured design decisions rather than copying text.
arms.screenshot: Use the supplied 1440×900 screenshot of the named CC0 starter as the visual reference. Do not receive a Piggyback brief, DESIGN.md, or starter source. Infer the design and reproduce its visual language for the task content.
arms.skill-alone: Use the named design skill's supplied instructions and the supplied 1440×900 screenshot of the named CC0 starter as your design guidance. Do not receive a Piggyback brief or starter source.
arms.skill-plus-piggyback: Use the named design skill's same instructions, the same 1440×900 screenshot of the named CC0 starter, and the supplied Piggyback BRIEF.md measured from it. Do not receive starter source. If the brief and the screenshot seem to conflict, follow the measured brief for visual values and the task for content.

T01.build_request: Build a fleet-operations dashboard for a coastal research team: status summary, one prominent signal, vessel/asset table, and acknowledge CTA.

T02.build_request: Build a portfolio homepage for an independent book designer: concise introduction, three selected projects, and contact CTA.

T03.build_request: Build the lead story page for an independent architecture journal: feature headline, standfirst, byline, article opening, related stories, subscribe CTA.

T04.build_request: Build a pricing page for an independent print magazine: three subscription options, clear differences, and one subscribe CTA.

T05.build_request: Build a small urban farm's homepage: seasonal produce, growing approach, weekly market details, and visit/order CTA.

T06.build_request: Build a neighborhood skills-swap event page: event details, three activities, access information, and save-your-place CTA.

T07.build_request: Build a maintenance overview for a small public-transport operator: service status, urgent alert, route table, and report-issue CTA.

T08.build_request: Build a consultant's portfolio for an independent accessibility researcher: introduction, three case studies, and inquiry CTA.

T09.build_request: Build an editorial story page for a local history publication: headline, deck, author/date, body opening, related cards, and membership CTA.

T10.build_request: Build a nonprofit community-garden homepage: mission, volunteer schedule, produce share, and volunteer CTA.
